recorded_from_commit: card/222-interior-page-frame, branched from main at 721fda8 (the registry delta of 2026-10-17, which carries CON-018's amendment). Recorded against this card's own implementation on its worktree, after the margins and the page frame were in place and before any fixture was written, exactly as CARD-205 and CARD-221 recorded theirs.
read_back_through: tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages -- the pages decoded out of the exported interior PDF, not the in-memory bitmaps
why_a_new_baseline: CARD-222 lands CON-018's amendment of 2026-10-17: the outside margin moves 0.375 -> 0.5 in, the top to 0.55 in and the bottom to 0.47 in, with the gutter deliberately unchanged at KDP's 0.5 in. Every interior page's text block therefore moves and shrinks -- usable width 193.675 -> 190.5 mm (-1.64%), usable height 260.35 -> 253.492 mm (-2.63%) -- so every fitted cell that was not already at the 7.5 mm cap is about 1.6% smaller and every mark on every page sits at a new y. The same card gives each puzzle page the frame the owner's 'Puzzle page layout' artifact asks for: a 0.6 pt rule inside the title band, a 0.4 pt hairline above the footer, the grid size on the footer's inner side and the folio at its centre. Both are deliberate, reader-visible changes, which is why this file exists rather than the previous one being regenerated.
warning: This is evidence of what the book PDF looks like with CON-018's amended margins and CARD-222's page frame in place. It must NEVER be regenerated to make a test pass: a page that stops matching it is either a deliberate change -- which earns its own successor file, with its own note -- or a regression.
interior_colorspace_note: What every page of this interior declares (CARD-147's own fact, unaffected by CARD-201). NOT the same as each page entry's 'mode' below, which is 'RGB' and always will be: that field is what tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages normalises every page to before digesting it, regardless of the file's own declared colour space.
font_dependent_pages_note: EMPTY, as CARD-221 left it: every reader-facing interior face is the packaged DejaVu Sans, so no page's pixels depend on the host. CARD-222 adds one more face to the interior (the footer's grid-size label) and sets it in that same packaged font.
interior_bytes_note: The black-and-white interior of this book: 3313912 bytes, where CARD-221's recording held 3464123 (-150211, -4.34%). Recorded because it is what the file does, not because it was predicted: the direction is the JPEG encoder's and not a measure of how much ink the pages hold.
changed_pages_note: 13 of 13 pages, measured page by page against CARD-221's recording before this file was written. Every page is expected to move: the amended margins move the text block on all of them, and the frame adds ink to the puzzle pages on top of that. A page that did NOT move would be the surprise.
